title: Perfect for the chef of your house!
text: Perfect for the chef of your house!. Great potato cutter. I purchased this along with a Fry Daddy so I could easily make my own French fries. I was pleasantly surprised at how well made it and easy to use (and to clean). Several attachments to make different size cuts makes this a must own for any chef. I love it!

product_metadata.title: Culina French Fry Potato Cutter for Easy Slicing, 2 Blades
features: Curved bottom design for easy fit of the vegetable, no force on the handle required
BPA-Free, Restaurant quality fry cut, great for other vegetables: cucumber, zuchinis etc…
The suction base keeps the cutter stable while in use
2 stainless steel blade size options. Easy to change with a simple but secure click
description: Are you looking to feed your family French fries they can trust? Trying to avoid the unhealthy mixtures that pass for food lately? Culina French Fry Cutter is the kitchen essential you have been looking for. Obtain incredible fries with the simplest of manipulation. Making your own foodie French fries doesn't have to be a hassle anymore, ladies and gents: it's a culinary affair. Sleek, sophisticated design, great performance If we told you that making your own potato fries from the actual produce (as opposed to who knows what strange matter fast food fries are made of?) is as easy as 1, 2, 3; would you believe it? The trick? Ok, there's a trick behind our perfect fries: the bottom part of the fry cutter is curved and specifically engineered to espouse the shape of a potato promoting a forceless operation. It's so easy you won't be able to stop yourself. Invite guest over and have them sample the abundant and delicious results! Ease of use, convenience and utilitarian service Culina Fry Cutter comes with a set of grids to adjust the vegetable cut to your size preference. Some of us like it thin some others larger. Simply pick the grid according to the desired fry size, place the potato facing the cutting grid, press down the handle and tadda! Geometrically perfect fries! NO force, just a quick, clean and painless motion on the handle. No strain! Great for cutting other veggies such as cucumbers, zucchinis and more! Your diet has just gotten fancier! A guilt-free, foodie experience all the while maintaining your weight goals? You bet! The blades are easy to change. Easy wash and maintenance ensure a long lasting service. And with all the great attributes from the alluring design to the gourmet concoction, you guessed it, Culina Fry Cutter makes a fantastic gift idea. Share the joy with family and friends for any occasion!
